Subject: Post-demo: Veridian security intake & VSQ + SOC2 Type II availability

Hi Elena — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and next steps from our side so procurement and security can get what you need:

- SOC 2 status: Redwood completed our SOC 2 Type II audit for the period Jan–Dec 2025; the Type II report is finalized and we can provide the full report under NDA or via our Trust Portal.
- Bridge letter: we can issue a temporary bridge attestation that covers the most-common customer questions while the report handoff happens.
- VSQ & DDQ: I attached our vendor security questionnaire (spreadsheet) and a short intake checklist. If Veridian has a custom DDQ, send it back and we’ll map controls.
- Data residency / HIPAA: Redwood supports US-region deployments; our Private offering can be scoped for HIPAA workloads. We also have an outline of technical safeguards we typically share for BAAs.

Next steps: can you confirm the primary security contact and procurement email to copy into the portal? Once I have that I’ll provision Trust Portal access and share the bridge letter & temporary artifacts. Proposed timeline: portal invite within 24 hours of confirmation, report/bridge docs within 48 hours for view.

Attaching: redwood_vendor_vsq_template.xlsx (VSQ template), 2026_SoC2_TypeII_bridge_letter_redwood.pdf (temporary attestation stub).

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
